purpose: Teach: 酵母/菜園/人影/たまらなく/敷き/知ったかぶる/恥じ/押せ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、家庭科で、本気で、絶対、酵母、絶対、習ったよね
lines.en: Riku, we definitely covered yeast in home ec, remember?
lines.style: Bright and direct, almost teasing. Quick cadence. Testing whether he'll engage with her. No hesitation in the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お祖父ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、菜園、絶対、立派なんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Your grandpa's vegetable garden is seriously impressive, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm admiration, genuine. Slow enough to land the compliment. Slight pride in the observation—he notices things about her. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夜の道で、本気で、絶対、お前の、絶対、人影、絶対、見えるとほっとするよ、リク
lines.en: When I see your figure on the road at night, it really does put my mind at ease, Riku.
lines.style: Tender and quiet. Soft opening. Vulnerable admission disguised as casual observation. Trailing off slightly, like she's saying more than she planned to. Breath under the words.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験前、本気で、絶対、お前の応援、絶対、たまらなく、絶対、欲しくなるぜ、桜
lines.en: Before exams, I find myself really wanting your support, you know?
lines.style: Earnest, almost reluctant honesty. Slight catch in the voice like he's admitting something he usually doesn't. Warm underneath but careful. Not performing—just saying it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 体育館の、本気で、絶対、敷き、絶対、マット、絶対、新しくなったよね、リク
lines.en: They replaced the gym mats with new ones, didn't they?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant. Observational tone—noticing small changes. Gentle curiosity. The pace of someone thinking as they speak, not rushing to fill space.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、知ったかぶる、絶対、ことなくて、絶対、誠実だよな、桜
lines.en: You don't pretend to know everything. You're genuinely sincere, Sakura.
lines.style: Steady and direct praise. Admiration with no irony. Slight emphasis on 「sincere」—he means it deeply. Warm but not softly; respectful rather than gentle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試合で、本気で、絶対、お前、絶対、失敗を、絶対、恥じる、絶対、ことなくて、絶対、立派だよ、リク
lines.en: During the match, you didn't shame yourself for failing. That was impressive, Riku.
lines.style: Genuine recognition, almost surprised by her own honesty in saying it. Warm but grounded. Slight pause before the compliment lands—she's choosing her words carefully because they matter.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 扉のボタンを、本気で、絶対、押せば、絶対、自動で、絶対、開くんだぜ、桜
lines.en: You press the button on the door and it opens automatically, right?
lines.style: Animated and present, almost cheerful. Quick rhythm. Pointing out something simple with childlike wonder or sudden realization. Bright energy, almost giddy.
